race.title: Betfair Backs Opinions Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: SALADINS SON finished runner-up in this corresponding event 12 months ago and can go one better in what looks a weaker renewal. Dexperts Opinion has made a bright start for the Bowen yard and looks the danger with the form of his Durham National second having been boosted. SALADINS SON (IRE) DEXPERTS OPINION (IRE) CAUGHTINYOURTRANCE (IRE)
